summary: TypeScript SDK: streaming chat drops/misses chunks under high throughput
description: Customer reports TS SDK streaming chat sometimes yields incomplete output (missing words/segments) while server logs show full token stream. Observed in Node 20 and Bun. Using redwood-sdk-typescript 2.4.0. They concatenate chunk deltas; output sometimes skips a delta event. Suspected cause: stream parser treats multi-line SSE events incorrectly when proxy coalesces packets.
comments: Support (Aisha): Asked for raw event payloads; customer attached a dump showing events that include multiple 'data:' lines.
Eng (Dylan): Reproduced with a local proxy that merges frames; our parser only reads first data line and ignores the rest. Will fix to accumulate all data lines until blank line terminator.
Eng (Dylan): Fix in progress; adding regression test with multiline SSE frames.
